description: Plugin approval vectors (CONTRACT.md, Plugins, What a plugin approval binds and The plugin approval page). Each binding and settings text is the jsonb text Postgres 16 returned for it, byte for byte; challenge is base64url (no padding) of sha256 of the binding text. expect gives what the page derives from the two texts alone: whether the settings text hashes to settingsSha256, then the level, whether the tick is shown, and the page's sentences in the order the contract fixes. A settings mismatch shows an error and no approve button. response is the JSON the page posts (response.schema.json); its byte fields are placeholders, not a real assertion. TestPluginApprovalVectors checks all of it. Pending: each vector's binding and challenge are replaced by "pending": true until the guard writes the store-neutral binding (store, agent:<name>; CONTRACT.md, Stores, Text rules); its settings and expect stay. A test that reads a pending vector fails.
